run_frames2videos_cli: run the frames2videos CLI to convert frame directories into MP4 videos for a dataset split
run_create_video: run create_video to encode a folder of RGB PNG frames into an MP4 video file
run_parse_args: run parse_args to configure input frames directory, output videos directory, split, and FPS settings
run_get_folders: run get_folders to discover and list all subdirectories under the input frames directory
run_main: run main to iterate over all frame folders and create MP4 videos from RGB PNG sequences
